patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient presents with her mother due to experiencing bizarre behavior for the past week following her father’s death from lung cancer. She has been hearing voices that are not present and experiencing intrusive thoughts.

Secondary_Symptoms: Voices discussing the patient in the third person and encouraging self-harm

patient_actor_hidden.Past_Medical_History: No history of medical or psychiatric illness.
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Patient denies the use of medications or substances. No notable social history provided.
patient_actor_hidden.Review_of_Systems: Denies fever, vomiting, headache, or any sensory disturbances other than auditory hallucinations.

objective_for_doctor: Assess, manage, and diagnose the patient presenting with symptoms of a psychiatric disorder, following recent bereavement.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Since my father died from lung cancer a little over a week ago, I’ve been having bizarre thoughts and I can’t stop intrusive worries. I’m also hearing voices that aren’t there, and they sometimes talk about me in the third person and tell me things I shouldn’t act on. I’m finding it hard to concentrate.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any swelling in your joints?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any joint swelling or pain—this has mostly been in my head with intrusive thoughts, hearing voices, and trouble focusing.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bumps, sores, or unusual spots on your scalp?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any bumps, sores, or unusual spots on my scalp. My main issue has been the voices and intrusive thoughts, and it’s been affecting my ability to focus.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itching or a persistent urge to scratch anywhere on your body?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had itching or any persistent urge to scratch anywhere on my body. It’s mostly the voices, intrusive thoughts, and trouble concentrating since my father’s death.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any trouble lifting your arms above your head?
turns.patient_answer: “I don’t have any trouble lifting my arms above my head, and I haven’t noticed any weakness or problems moving normally.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any loss of vision that isn’t accompanied by pain?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any loss of vision, and it hasn’t come with any pain. It’s mainly the voices, intrusive thoughts, and trouble concentrating that are bothering me most.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had a fever that’s felt extremely hot—like a temperature above 104 °F (40 °C) that’s made you feel dizzy or very uncomfortable?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any fever or felt extremely hot, and I haven’t been dizzy from illness. I’ve mostly felt overwhelmed by the intrusive thoughts and the voices, and it’s been making it hard to concentrate.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling unusually stressed or overwhelmed lately?
turns.patient_answer: “Yes, I’ve felt unusually overwhelmed and stressed since my father died—my mind won’t stop with intrusive worries, and the voices make it hard to focus on anything else.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you experienced any burning or discomfort when you urinate?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any burning or discomfort when I urinate. My symptoms have been centered on the intrusive thoughts and the voices, and they’ve been overwhelming me since my father died.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling chills lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had chills. It’s mostly been feeling overwhelmed and hearing voices that talk about me, along with intrusive thoughts that make it hard to concentrate.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any lumps or masses in your breasts that feel fixed or don’t move?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any lumps or masses in my breasts that feel fixed or don’t move. My main problem has been the intrusive thoughts, the voices, and trouble concentrating since my father’s death.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling any pain or discomfort on the side of your back or abdomen, between your ribs and hips?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any pain or discomfort on the side of my back or abdomen between my ribs and hips. It’s mostly the voices, intrusive thoughts, and difficulty concentrating that are taking up all my attention.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you feel pain in your calf when you walk, and does it go away when you stop and rest?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t have any calf pain when I walk, and it doesn’t happen—my main problems have been the intrusive thoughts and the voices, along with trouble concentrating since my father died.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that your urine looks darker than usual?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed that my urine looks darker than usual. My focus has mainly been on the intrusive thoughts and the voices making it hard for me to concentrate since my father died.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any difficulty moving your arm up or across your body?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any difficulty moving my arm up or across my body—my problems have been mainly the voices, intrusive thoughts, and trouble concentrating since my father died. I don’t have weakness or problems moving normally.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that your joints feel sore or stiff after doing the same activity repeatedly, like after a long day of typing, lifting, or other repetitive motions?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed my joints feeling sore or stiff after repetitive activities. This has mostly been mental—overwhelming intrusive thoughts and hearing voices that make it hard to concentrate.”
